findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 81b68a6c72193f71603d2b1b23f1cf943697a6cc1daefd36f9fbabded39e3695; all 5 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

Claims remain bounded to MRX first-party source and privacy disclosures, NIST voluntary risk-management context, and the FTC evidence boundary for specified AI accuracy or efficacy claims. None is converted into a promise of accuracy, completeness, reliability, safety, certification, or reduced risk.

The article invents no owner, record, public-source result, source match, review result, buyer, offer, title fact, acreage, tax result, testimonial, success rate, or owner-specific legal, tax, title, valuation, engineering, or transaction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Terms of Use and AI Disclosure (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The MRX terms disclose fictional AI interfaces, define website and chat content as educational, state that sources may be incomplete, delayed, or changed, and tell users to verify material facts.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the terms only for AI-interface, source-limitation, and material-fact-verification boundaries; it makes no appraisal, title, legal, tax, or professional conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Privacy Policy (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The MRX privacy policy describes source citations, structured owner facts with source and confidence information, authorized files, AI-assisted processing, and sensitive-information limits.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses this first-party policy only to support stable private source references and data minimization; it does not promise confidentiality, security, correctness, or legal compliance.

sources_inspected.label: NIST, AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: NIST describes AI RMF 1.0 as a voluntary framework for managing AI risks and organizes the core around Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage functions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the framework only as voluntary risk-management context and expressly does not claim that NIST requires, validates, or certifies the MRX three-label worksheet.

sources_inspected.label: NIST, AI Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: NIST identifies NIST.AI.600-1 as a cross-sectoral Generative AI Profile and companion to AI RMF 1.0 that proposes voluntary actions for generative-AI risk management.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the profile only as generative-AI risk context and does not convert it into proof of an output, owner fact, source match, or professional conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Federal Trade Commission, Final Workado AI Accuracy Order (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The FTC final Workado order requires evidence for the AI accuracy or efficacy claims described by the agency.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the order only to prohibit treating the existence of a source trace as evidence that an AI output is accurate, effective, or reliable; it makes no broader legal conclusion.
